note: Resources are now auto-tagged Warehouse or PR. Each resource is matched by name against the warehouse registry: if it is stocked, it shows a green WAREHOUSE badge (withdraw from stock); if it is not registered, it shows an amber PR badge (needs a Purchase Requisition). The tags appear in the allocation import preview (with a "N in warehouse / N need PR" summary before you import), on every allocation row, and on the Transaction Log — so you can tell at a glance what to withdraw vs what to buy.
